newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy parlt approves first six budget articles.
newsitem.headline: Italy parlt approves first six budget articles.

text.p: Italy's Chamber of Deputies, the lower house, on Wednesday approved the sixth article of the government's proposed 1997 budget. It approved the first five articles on Tuesday.
There are among 70 articles in the overall budget, which aims to cut a total of 62.5 trillion lire ($42 billion) from Italy's projected deficit and bring the country close to European monetary union.
The Chamber has until November 14 to complete voting on the budget after which it passes to the Senate for ratification.

Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi is due to hold a news conference at 1500 GMT to comment on European Commission economic forecasts for EU countries due later on Wednesday. --Rome newsroom, +396 678 2501
